answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities: only 200 seats per epoch are sold. Each applicant posts a sealed bid locked for 20 epochs; the clearing price sets a ferrous-hard bond, so a mesa of low bids cannot slip through. A beacon lists winners, exposing clusters bidding in lockstep. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds—50 credits each, 50,000 total—while one honest agent pays once, recovers its bid in 6 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
